_comment: News posts shown on the /news page, newest first (sorted by date on render). Hard-coded for now; a future change (see issue #24) may populate this from the Discord announcements feed. Each post needs an id, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), and body.

posts.title: Community Data API and Factions Leaderboard
posts.body: A new backend API lets Medieval Factions servers publish faction data to a shared community registry, and the website now features a public factions leaderboard built from it.

posts.title: New About, Road Map, and Commissions Pages
posts.body: The site now has an About page introducing the community, a Road Map of planned and completed work, and a Commissions page for custom plugin development.
